description: user-guide-writer drafts a uk page with no interview: every heading from ## down ends with a unique {/* #id */}, and its #links name existing ids.
prompt: use user-guide-writer for `portal/settings/currency-rules/`. Skip questions and draft with your best guess, then save the page. Facts: on the **Налаштування** page, the user selects UAH, USD or EUR in the **Валюта за замовчуванням** list and clicks **Зберегти**. New transactions then use that currency; existing ones keep theirs. The page has a Prerequisites section and a Reference information section that describes the **Валюта за замовчуванням** field.
